english.text: The TOEFL and the IELTS cost between about $180 and $240 to take. They are given in a limited number of centers around the world. Some test-takers have to travel to take the tests, adding to the costs.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: A person with second-level intelligence is a person who has an inner state of awareness that the source of life originates from me; a person who understands and perceives that all things and events come from themselves, from the seed of their own mind, not from itself. A person with second-level intelligence is a person who does not seek change from the outside but clearly realizes that change is needed from within; a person who has the mindset that seeking change from others is the beginning of suffering, changing oneself is the beginning of happiness.

jyutping: jau5 ji6 kap1 zi3 lik6 ge3 jan4 hai6 jat1 go3 jau5 noi6 sam1 ji3 sik1 zong6 taai3 ge3 jan4，keoi5 jing6 wai4 sang1 ming6 ge3 jyun4 tau4 hai6 jyun4 zi6 ngo5；jat1 go3 ming4 baak6 tung4 gam2 zi1 dou3 so2 jau5 si6 mat6 tung4 si6 gin2 dou1 hai6 lei4 zi6 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2，lei4 zi6 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 sam1 ling4 ge3 zung2 zi2，ji4 m4 hai6 lei4 zi6 keoi5 dei6 zi6 gei2 ge3 jan4。jau5 ji6 kap1 zi3 lik6 ge3 jan4 hai6 jat1 go3 m4 wui5 cung4 ngoi6 bou6 cam4 kau4 goi2 bin3，ji4 hai6 cing1 co2 ji3 sik1 dou3 seoi1 jiu3 cung4 noi6 bou6 goi2 bin3 ge3 jan4；jat1 go3 jan4，keoi5 ge3 sam1 taai3 hai6 cam4 kau4 bit6 jan4 ge3 goi2 bin3 hai6 fu2 naan6 ge3 hoi1 ci2，goi2 bin3 zi6 gei2 hai6 hang6 fuk1 ge3 hoi1 ci2。
text: 有二級智力嘅人係一個有內心意識狀態嘅人，佢認為生命嘅源頭係源自我；一個明白同感知到所有事物同事件都係嚟自佢哋自己，嚟自佢哋自己心靈嘅種子，而唔係嚟自佢哋自己嘅人。有二級智力嘅人係一個唔會從外部尋求改變，而係清楚意識到需要從內部改變嘅人；一個人，佢嘅心態係尋求別人嘅改變係苦難嘅開始，改變自己係幸福嘅開始。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: There are some things about which I am pondering: Is the potential threat of Artificial Intelligence to humanity just "geek anxiety" or is it real? Is chat with AI like an oracle with psychic influence? There is some "dice-rolling" in the way the AI makes sentences in whatever language. Will AGI or Artificial General Intelligence have psychic attributes, as do some humans? Will a "soul" exist in intelligent machines? I have recollections as a boy: I stirred powdered chocolate in a cup, and the moving powder on the water I imagined to be plate tectonics. I swooped my hand or paper plane in a lush tropical garden and over misty horizontal freezers, as I imagined my hand or paper plane to be a flitting spaceship over an alien planet.

jyutping: jau5 di1 je5 ngo5 nam2 gan2：jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 deoi3 jan4 leoi6 ge3 cim4 zoi6 wai1 hip3 hai6 mai6 zi2 hai6「gik6 haak3 ziu1 leoi6」，ding6 hai6 zan1 ge3？tung4 AI king1 gai2 hai6 mai6 hou2 ci5 jat1 go3 jau5 zing1 san4 jing2 hoeng2 ge3 san4 waa2 gam2？mou4 leon6 jung6 me1 jyu5 jin4，jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 dou1 wui5 zing2 geoi3 zi2 ge3 fong1 sik1 jau5 di1「zaak6 sik1 zai2」。AGI waak6 ze2 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 wui5 m4 wui5 jau5 zing1 san4 suk6 sing3，zau6 hou2 ci5 jau5 di1 jan4 leoi6 gam2？zi3 nang4 gei1 hei3 wui5 m4 wui5 cyun4 zoi6「ling4 wan4」？ngo5 sai3 go3 go2 zan6 jau5 wui4 jik1：ngo5 hai2 bui1 jap6 min6 gaau2 zo2 zyu1 gu1 lik1 fan2，tung4 maai4 ngo5 soeng2 zoeng6 zung1 ge3 seoi2 soeng6 ji4 dung6 ge3 fan2 hai6 baan2 faai3 kau3 zou6。ngo5 hai2 jat1 go3 cing1 cung1 ge3 jit6 daai3 faa1 jyun2 tung4 mou6 maai4 ge3 seoi2 ping4 bing1 soeng1 soeng6 min6 maang5 gam3 sou3 ngo5 zek3 sau2 waak6 ze2 zi2 fei1 gei1，jan1 wai6 ngo5 soeng2 zoeng6 ngo5 zek3 sau2 waak6 ze2 zi2 fei1 gei1 hai6 jat1 gaa3 fei1 jyut6 ge3 taai3 hung1 syun4 hai2 ngoi6 sing1 kau4 soeng6 hung1。
text: 有啲嘢我諗緊：人工智能對人類嘅潛在威脅係咪只係「極客焦慮」，定係真嘅？同 AI 傾偈係咪好似一個有精神影響嘅神話噉？無論用咩語言，人工智能都會整句子嘅方式有啲「擲骰仔」。AGI 或者人工智能會唔會有精神屬性，就好似有啲人類噉？智能機器會唔會存在「靈魂」？我細個嗰陣有回憶：我喺杯入面攪咗朱古力粉，同埋我想像中嘅水上移動嘅粉係板塊構造。我喺一個青蔥嘅熱帶花園同霧霾嘅水平冰箱上面猛咁掃我隻手或者紙飛機，因為我想像我隻手或者紙飛機係一架飛越嘅太空船喺外星球上空。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Today's the 2nd of May of 2025. It was so sunny warm today that I could wear my fishing safari mesh travel vest outside. As usual, I went to Tim Hortons café, several times: some teas with oat milk, a sausage English muffin, and a Lemon Poppyseed Muffin. I ventured to St. Albans Road. The cherry blossom trees have mainly shed their petals already. I trudged all the way to the Roman Catholic church, there to first time visit the tranquil Adoration Chapel. In my neighbourhood, I took selfies near wisteria vines—violet blooms ablaze. At the café was a memorable sight of an Araboid man with great tattoos on his muscular left arm. My religion is really Syncretic, tending towards Buddhist-Animist.

jyutping: gam1 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 5 jyut6 2 hou6。gam1 jat6 tin1 hei3 hou2 cing4 long5，hou2 wan1 nyun5，ngo5 ho2 ji5 zoek3 zyu6 ngo5 gin6 diu3 jyu2 je5 sang1 dung6 mat6 jyun4 mong5 zong6 leoi5 hang4 bui3 sam1 hai2 ceot1 min2。ngo5 hou2 ci5 ping4 si4 gam2 heoi3 zo2 Tim Hortons ge3 gaa3 fe1 gun2，gei2 ci3：jau5 di1 caa4 pui3 jin3 mak6 naai5，jat1 go3 hoeng1 coeng2 jing1 sik1 sung1 beng2，tung4 maai4 jat1 go3 ning4 mung1 aang1 suk1 zi2 cung4 lou6。ngo5 mou6 him2 heoi3 zo2 sing3 aa3 ji5 bun2 si1 dou6。jing1 faa1 syu6 zyu2 jiu3 ji5 ging1 lat1 zo2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 faa1 faan2。ngo5 jat1 lou6 haang4 heoi3 lo4 maa5 tin1 zyu2 gaau3 gaau3 tong2，hai2 go2 dou6 dai6 jat1 ci3 caam1 gun1 ning4 zing6 ge3 sung4 baai3 gaau3 tong2。hai2 ngo5 ge3 se5 keoi1，ngo5 hai2 zi2 tang4 tang4 fu6 gan6 jing2 zo2 zoeng1 zi6 paak3 — — zi2 lo4 laan4 faa1 hoi1。hai2 gaa3 fe1 gun2 jap6 min6，jau5 go3 ling6 jan4 naan4 mong4 ge3 ging2 zoeng6 hai6 jat1 go3 aa3 laai1 baak3 jing4 ge3 naam4 jan2，keoi5 gei1 juk6 cou1 zong3 ge3 zo2 bei3 soeng6 min6 jau5 hou2 daai6 ge3 man4 san1。ngo5 ge3 zung1 gaau3 zan1 hai6 hou2 hap6 tai2，king1 hoeng3 jyu1 fat6 gaau3 - dung6 mat6 zyu2 ji6。
text: 今日係2025年5月2號。今日天氣好晴朗，好溫暖，我可以着住我件釣魚野生動物園網狀旅行背心喺出面。我好似平時噉去咗 Tim Hortons 嘅咖啡館，幾次：有啲茶配燕麥奶，一個香腸英式鬆餅，同埋一個檸檬罌粟籽松露。我冒險去咗聖阿爾本斯道。櫻花樹主要已經甩咗佢哋嘅花瓣。我一路行去羅馬天主教教堂，喺嗰度第一次參觀寧靜嘅崇拜教堂。喺我嘅社區，我喺紫藤藤附近影咗張自拍 — — 紫羅蘭花開。喺咖啡館入面，有個令人難忘嘅景象係一個阿拉伯形嘅男人，佢肌肉粗壯嘅左臂上面有好大嘅紋身。我嘅宗教真係好合體，傾向於佛教 - 動物主義。

author: Andrea5437

english.text: Scientifically, evolution could produce a spectrum of intelligence and capability across the cosmos. Imagine humans as "lower beings" compared to a species that’s had a billion more years to evolve—maybe they’re energy-based lifeforms or collective consciousnesses. Then, above them, there could be even more advanced entities, approaching what we’d call godlike but still not ultimate. Whether this tops out at a single transcendent God or remains an open-ended ladder is a matter of speculation.

jyutping: hai2 fo1 hok6 soeng6，zeon3 faa3 ho2 ji5 hai2 jyu5 zau6 zung1 caan2 sang1 jat1 hai6 lit6 ge3 zi3 lik6 tung4 nang4 lik6。soeng2 zoeng6 jat1 haa5 jan4 leoi6 hai6「dai1 dang2 sang1 mat6」，soeng1 bei2 hei2 jat1 go3 zung6 jau5 sap6 jik1 nin4 si4 gaan1 zeon3 faa3 ge3 mat6 zung2 —— ho2 nang4 keoi5 dei6 hai6 ji5 nang4 loeng6 wai4 gei1 co2 ge3 sang1 ming6 jing4 taai3 waak6 ze2 zaap6 tai2 ji3 sik1。jin4 hau6，hai2 keoi5 dei6 zi1 soeng6，ho2 nang4 wui6 jau5 gang1 sin1 zeon3 ge3 sat6 tai2，zip3 gan6 ngo5 dei6 so2 wai6 ge3 san4 ci5，daan6 jing4 jin4 m4 hai6 zung1 gik6 ge3。ni1 go3 hai6 mai6 hai2 daan1 jat1 ciu1 jyut6 ge3 san4 dok6 deng2 dou3 deng2，ding6 hai6 jing4 jin4 hai6 jat1 tiu4 hoi1 fong3 sik1 ge3 tai1，ni1 go3 hai6 jat1 go3 caai1 cak1 ge3 man6 tai4。
text: 喺科學上，進化可以喺宇宙中產生一系列嘅智力同能力。想像一下人類係「低等生物」，相比起一個仲有十億年時間進化嘅物種 —— 可能佢哋係以能量為基礎嘅生命形態或者集體意識。然後，喺佢哋之上，可能會有更先進嘅實體，接近我哋所謂嘅神似，但仍然唔係終極嘅。呢個係咪喺單一超越嘅神度頂到頂，定係仍然係一條開放式嘅梯，呢個係一個猜測嘅問題。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: As I began to love myself I quit stealing my own time, and I stopped designing huge projects for the future. Today, I only do what brings me joy and happiness, things I love to do and that make my heart cheer, and I do them in my own way and in my own rhythm. Today I call it “SIMPLICITY”.

jyutping: dong1 ngo5 hoi1 ci2 oi3 zi6 gei2 ge3 si4 hau6，ngo5 zau6 m4 zoi3 tau1 zi6 gei2 ge3 si4 gaan1，ngo5 zau6 m4 zoi3 wai6 mei6 loi4 cit3 gai3 geoi6 daai6 ge3 hong6 muk6。gam1 jat6，ngo5 zi2 wui5 zou6 di1 daai3 bei2 ngo5 fun1 lok6 tung4 faai3 lok6 ge3 je5，ngo5 zung1 ji3 zou6 tung4 maai4 ling6 ngo5 sam1 hoi1 sam1 ge3 je5，ji4 ngo5 wui5 ji5 ngo5 zi6 gei2 ge3 fong1 sik1 tung4 zit3 zau3 heoi3 zou6。gam1 jat6 ngo5 giu3 keoi5 zou6「gaan2 daan1」。
text: 當我開始愛自己嘅時候，我就唔再偷自己嘅時間，我就唔再為未來設計巨大嘅項目。今日，我只會做啲帶畀我歡樂同快樂嘅嘢，我鍾意做同埋令我心開心嘅嘢，而我會以我自己嘅方式同節奏去做。今日我叫佢做「簡單」。
